controls.label: BRSRV EVM master and upgrade owner
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 26110197: token owner and TrustService 0x6c0e8dfb1682a1659a1ab9add9d43058be132921 MASTER role both resolve to this code-empty EOA. It can call native issueTokens directly, change services and replace token/trust logic immediately. Full trust role-event replay and getRole confirm this sole MASTER; previous masters were removed. Tempo's earlier pin reports the same owner but not an exhaustive chain-local role census.

All getRole values match exhaustive add/remove-event replay. First four issuers are proxies; latter two, MASTER and TRANSFER_AGENT have empty code. Proxies resolve to TokenIssuer 0x4ef34664ccbf1979180a9f3cb21f033e069713ba, WalletRegistrar 0xb886f567219a39b49a68115207787dce0a10b9e6, and unverified implementations 0x9394de9e0e1c7274da58a6b6ae246182a23c347f / 0x77305a8503a576f61f6c8639c8cb287b6b751840. Full proxy execution closure is not established.

controls.label: BRSRV Solana Token-2022 mint authority

sources.label: Solana finalized authority and upgradeable-program reads

controls.evidence: Earlier finalized slot 452748384 reports this mint/freeze authority and permanent delegate on the Token-2022 mint. Finalized slot 452863785 getAccountInfo establishes this as a 73-byte non-executable program-owned authority account, owned by 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP. Slot 452863819 identifies that executable program as BPF-upgradeable with ProgramData 7u9rE6ESU4c831q4tGQBDA12zpVjRruEHYjT25mKN7V1; slot 452863856 identifies upgrade authority 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6. Program source, signing rules and upgrade-authority quorum remain unestablished; no EOA or immutability inference is made.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 26110197 native TrustService RoleAdded/RoleRemoved replay and getRole/code checks resolve one MASTER, six ISSUERs and one TRANSFER_AGENT listed in the native service control. Four issuer contracts are ERC-1967 proxies, two with unverified current implementations; issuer role membership is known but complete implementation authorization/bypass closure is not. MASTER can mint and immediately upgrade both token and trust service. Solana finalized account reads bind the mint authority to executable upgradeable program 7tXjmbkZVY3Gmg9kDBebcNXT1yC5pyoxxXVLwdbv9tvP and ProgramData upgrade authority 8d36iv2YUD8yDChuVZchx1NqE4qkDWCAEgsUEEUqzbB6; they do not prove signing policy. Tempo native path remains independently unresolved. Daily issuer portfolio/NAV publication supplies no current independently signed token-liability reconciliation. Organizational key custody of the four identified Ethereum ISSUER proxies remains unestablished. Current independently signed whole-token fund reconciliation remains unavailable. Sibling comparison on 2026-10-03: BUIDL's attestation-only supervision, continuous reconciliation and unbounded-reconciled posture cite Chronicle's BUIDL-specific proof-of-asset service. Chronicle's methodology describes independently validated data sourced from custodians, NAV administrators or authorized agents and published on-chain; its rendered fund directory and BUIDL dashboard identify BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund/BUIDL, not BlackRock Daily Reinvestment Stablecoin Reserve Vehicle/BRSRV/RSVXX. No BRSRV-specific coverage entry or equivalent continuous source-level verification series was established in that inventory or the reviewed BRSRV primary disclosures. The common Securitize transfer agent and similar programmable-share administration do not establish that Chronicle's BUIDL assurance also covers this distinct fund. BRSRV's daily issuer holdings/NAV and monthly SEC N-MFP3 portfolio/NAV disclosure do not themselves supply the missing whole-token continuous reserve/liability verification. Reconciliation and supervision therefore remain unknown, with concentrated-admin posture and the separately unresolved technical paths retained rather than inheriting the sibling's product-scoped assurance.
